# Account Executive

Lassie•

San Francisco, CA

• Full Time

## Job Description

Our mission is to help small businesses run themselves. We’re starting with doctors’ offices, building autonomous systems that handle busywork and complete the workflows that keep the office moving every day. Our team is small, flat, and ambitious. We value craft, intellectual rigor, and direct communication.

### About the role

As an Account Executive at Lassie, you'll help the doctors’ offices understand what becomes possible when AI agents take on real operational work. You know how to build a pipeline, run demos, diagnose customer pain (or identify goals), build trust with SMB owners and staffers, and close customers ready to run a more automated office.

### What you'll do

- Own a full-cycle SMB sales motion (prospecting, demos, follow-ups, close) against a monthly quota
- Represent the Lassie brand and unlock referrals by building relationships with doctors, business owners, and communities
- Improve Lassie's GTM playbook: what messaging converts, how to handle objections, and what the ideal customer looks like
- Bring market feed

# Patientdesk AI Raises $1M Pre-Seed Backed by Y Combinator to Modernize Dental Front Desks

- James Dargan
- February 25, 2026
- 7 min read

Insider Brief

- Patientdesk AI, a Y Combinator W26 startup, raised $1 million in pre-seed funding led by Y Combinator and E2VC to develop a patient-aware AI front desk system for dental clinics.
- The platform automates the full intake process, including answering calls, qualifying patients, booking appointments, verifying insurance in real time, and handling payments, integrating directly with clinic management systems.
- Already deployed in over 60 clinics across the U.S., U.K., and Australia, the company plans to expand insurance verification features, deepen system integrations, and scale to larger dental groups.

PRESS RELEASE — Patientdesk AI, a Y Combinator-backed startup building patient-aware AI for dental clinics, announced it has raised a $1 million pre-seed round led by Y Combinator and E2VC.

_request.systemPrompt: You are sourcing target accounts for an AI-native account-based-marketing (ABM) platform. Return real, currently-operating US venture-backed startups (seed to Series B, roughly 10-200 employees) that build vertical B2B software or AI products sold to FRAGMENTED SMB/mid-market buyers such as medical practices, dental groups, law firms, trucking and logistics operators, home-services or construction back-offices. Prefer companies with recent funding, visible go-to-market hiring, and a founder-led or first-sales-hire motion. Exclude enterprise incumbents, public companies, pure consumer apps, and companies over 1,000 employees. Exclude Insight Health. Ground every company in a real page.
